newsitem.title: USA: Australian on lam from UK murder charge nabbed in US.
newsitem.headline: Australian on lam from UK murder charge nabbed in US.

text.p: Police in Colorado Thursday arrested a 27-year-old Australian man wanted in Britain for allegedly brutally beating and stabbing his former employer, the U.S. office of Interpol said in a statement.
Gregory Adam Mills was stopped and detained by the Colorado Highway Patrol for driving too fast immediately following the broadcast of an area-wide wanted person bulletin.
He was being held by the Immigration and Naturalisation Service in Denver, pending proceedings for his return to Britain, The U.S. National Central Bureau of Interpol said.
Mills allegedly murdered the victim while robbing her residence and business establishment on April 18, according to British police.

Interpol organised a meeting of U.S. Interpol and law enforcement officials with British authorities regarding the investigation, later developing information which showed Mills left Britain and travelled through New York before arriving in Colorado.
